# Cursor

> > Cursor is an AI-powered code editor with an extensible plugin marketplace supporting MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations for development workflows.

The Cursor Marketplace enables developers to extend their coding environment with plugins for cloud platforms (AWS, Cloudflare, Databricks), authentication (Clerk), databases (Prisma, Redis), AI/ML tools (Hugging Face), security scanning (Snyk), project management (Atlassian, Notion), and specialized development frameworks. Plugins leverage MCP servers to provide seamless integration with external services and automation capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- MCP Server Integration
- Cursor Plugin Development
- AI-Assisted Coding
- Agent Orchestration
- Hugging Face Hub
- Database Development (Prisma, Redis)
- Cloud Deployment (AWS, Cloudflare)
- Authentication & Security (Clerk, Snyk)
- Task Management (Atlassian, Notion)
- React & Frontend Development
- Docker & Python Development
- Playwright Testing
- Dataset Management & ML Training

## Plugin Development

- [Create Plugin](https://cursor.com/marketplace/cursor/create-plugin): Plugin scaffolding tool for marketplace submission and validation

## Cloud & Infrastructure

- [AWS](https://cursor.com/marketplace/aws): AWS deployment with IaC, architecture recommendations, and cost estimates
- [Cloudflare](https://cursor.com/marketplace/cloudflare): Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, and Agents SDK development tools
- [Databricks](https://cursor.com/marketplace/databricks): Databricks CLI, Unity Catalog, and Model Serving integration skills

## Database & Data Management

- [Prisma](https://cursor.com/marketplace/prisma): Official Prisma plugin with MCP server for database development automation
- [Redis](https://cursor.com/marketplace/redis): Redis development with vector search, caching, and query engine support

## AI & Machine Learning

- [Hugging Face](https://cursor.com/marketplace/huggingface): Hugging Face Hub integration for AI/ML tasks, datasets, and model training

## Security & Authentication

- [Clerk](https://cursor.com/marketplace/clerk): Clerk authentication toolkit with Next.js integration and MCP server
- [Snyk](https://cursor.com/marketplace/snyk): Snyk security scanning and vulnerability remediation for dependencies
- [Runlayer](https://cursor.com/marketplace/runlayer): MCP orchestration with security policies, secrets management, and audit logs

## Productivity & Collaboration

- [Atlassian](https://cursor.com/marketplace/atlassian): Jira and Confluence integration with MCP for task and backlog management
- [Notion](https://cursor.com/marketplace/notion): Notion Skills and MCP server for database and task management integration
- [Compound Engineering](https://cursor.com/marketplace/every): 29 agents for code review, research, design, and workflow automation

## Monitoring & Specialized Tools

- [Datadog](https://cursor.com/marketplace/datadog): Datadog MCP server for querying logs, metrics, traces, and dashboards
- [Meta Reality Labs](https://cursor.com/marketplace/meta-reality-labs): Meta Quest and Horizon OS development with Unity and Spatial SDK support
- [Phantom Connect](https://cursor.com/marketplace/phantom): Phantom wallet integration for multi-chain crypto operations and signing
